exercises.question: In the sentence 'Rátz tanár úr a diákokkal vezettette le az új tételt', why is 'a diákokkal' in the instrumental case (-val/-vel)?
options: Because 'levezet' is a transitive verb with its own direct object ('az új tételt'), so the causee takes -val/-vel.
Because 'diákok' is the direct object of the base verb.
Because every plural noun in Hungarian takes -val/-vel in the past tense.
Because 'levezet' means 'to accompany someone by bus'.
